base_url.correction: REST/server SDK host is environment-specific (e.g. https://api.sandbox.braintreegateway.com for sandbox; production is https://api.braintreegateway.com). GraphQL uses https://payments.braintree-api.com/graphql (prod) and https://payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com/graphql (sandbox) — not a single base of https://api.braintreegateway.com alone.

free_tier_limits.correction: Sandbox is free. Production US card rates are typically 2.59% + $0.49 for Braintree Direct (confirm current regional pricing); do not treat the parenthetical US card figure as a universal free-tier limit.
